prop.description: Use when someone asks how to learn, get started with, or roll out Claude to a team or class: covers get started, course, new hires, learning hub, pre-work
triggers: How do I get started with Claude for my organization?
Is there a course or tutorial I can assign to new hires?
Merging two Word docs into one office document while keeping the comments should go to office-docs/docx
synonyms: course, 课程, 培训, 培训计划, 培训内容
get started, 上手
prop.why: Dropped the generic cover words (onboarding, training, learning) that caused false landings on xlsx/no-skill requests, replaced them with specific request phrases, and rewrote the negative sentence so it carries office-docs/docx wording (office, word doc) instead of stopping at root.

prop.description: Use when creating generative art with code and seeded randomness: covers generative art, algorithmic, flow field, particle; excludes debugging existing code
triggers: make generative art with p5.js
create a flow field particle animation
draw a poster for the launch should go to canvas-design

flow field, 流场风格, 流场动画, 流动线条, 流动线条动画

prop.description: Use when code calls Claude or the Anthropic SDK, or exposes an internal service to Claude as tools: covers claude, anthropic sdk, prompt caching, model migration; excludes other providers
triggers: stream a response from the Claude API in Python and enable prompt caching
connect our internal asset library to Claude with a small Python MCP server
draft a short status update for leadership on the rollout timeline should go to internal-comms
synonyms: model migration, 老型号, 模型迁移, 迁移到最新
prompt caching, 缓存, 提示词缓存, 系统提示词
prop.why: Added bare 'claude' as a cover word so the Claude-naming MCP/streaming triggers lexically reach the skill (they only hit mcp-builder before), dropped 'tool use' which was grabbing OpenAI tool-use requests, and replaced the dangling 'openai' negative target with an existing top-level skill (internal-comms) reached via the 'status update' alias.

prop.description: Use when co-writing a structured doc with the user through drafts: covers co-author, technical spec, decision doc; excludes editor pitches
triggers: 帮我一起写一份技术方案，先对一下大纲、读者和边界，再逐节填充。
Help me co-author a technical spec for our engineering team, starting with the outline and then filling it in section by section.
Draft a 200-word recommendation memo for my editor about the water utility series should go to discernment-nudge
synonyms: technical spec, 技术方案, 技术方案文档, 技术方案书
decision doc, 决策记录, 架构决策记录, 决策文档
prop.why: The Chinese positive only failed because 技术方案/决策记录 were missing aliases of the existing cover words, so adding those two alias groups lets the sentence lexically land on this skill; the negative now carries discernment-nudge's own cover words (recommendation, memo) so it reaches its target instead of root.

prop.description: Use when creating, tuning or benchmarking an agent skill and its description: covers create a new skill, reusable skill, existing skill, trigger reliably; excludes mcp server

our existing skill does not trigger reliably, review it, improve the description and set up evals before and after
build an MCP server for our ticket system should go to mcp-builder
synonyms: create a new skill, build a new skill, write a new skill, 新建技能
prop.why: Dropped generic 'reusable' (deck false load) and bare 'skill' (organizer/editing/web ambiguity FAILs), replacing them with request-level phrases 'create a new skill', 'reusable skill', 'existing skill' that still lexically reach both positives and the create-from-zero miss while never matching the deck, sub-skill, absorb-this-new-skill or duplicate-skill requests.

prop.description: Use when styling an artifact with a reusable color/font theme: covers theme, palette, typeface, visual treatment; excludes brand color
